title: electron-error-capture configuration
description: Volatile knobs for the capture harness, per the External-Orchestration Config Pattern: output filenames, launch defaults, per-platform binary fallbacks, the five listener channels and the three pattern-derived classifications. SKILL.md stays command-agnostic; everything that drifts lives here.

screenshotPattern.description: Screenshot filename template. Must carry the {n} placeholder, or every screenshot overwrites the last.

listeners.description: The channels backed by a real Playwright or process hook. This list is what the harness can claim coverage of.

hook.description: The literal hook this channel is wired to. Present so a reader can check the claim against the script.

isError.description: Whether entries on this channel count toward the error total. Warnings are opt-in and do not.

derivedClassifications.description: NOT hooks. Patterns matched over what the listeners emit, so the report can label them as inferred rather than observed.

appliesTo.description: Listener ids this classification may fire on. Narrowing it is what stops a console line quoting stderr from being reclassified.

patterns.description: Regular-expression sources. minItems is 1 deliberately: a classification with no patterns can never fire, and would report as clean rather than as broken.

flags.description: Optional RegExp flags. `g` is excluded on purpose — a global regex carries lastIndex between calls and would match every other line.
